newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: PRESS DIGEST - Bangladesh Newspapers - Aug 4.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Bangladesh Newspapers - Aug 4.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Bangladesh press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
The government is considering an ammendment to the Bank Company Act to relax restriction on providing credits to subsidiary enterprises of loan defaulting companies.
The government has taken diplomatic initiatives to fix an immediate schedule for a high-level meeting with Burmese authorities to discuss refugee issues.
Bangladesh has sought technical assistance from the European Union for monitoring frozen foods processing, withholding its embargo.
Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina, now visiting the United States, on Sunday called upon expatriate Bangladeshis to invest at home in a bigger way.
Bangladesh will receive $239 million in soft loan from the International Development Association (IDA) to fund infrastructure projects by the private sector.
Water experts from India and Bangladesh on Sunday held a meeting at a border town to dicuss water sharing of the Teesta river.
Informal economy accounts for about 23 percent of the country's Gross Domestic Product (GDP), a study says.
Finance Minister S.A.M.S. Kibria said on Sunday he had asked banks to liquidate industrial units which lost potentials to be rehabilitated. REUTER
